blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Tilbury

items.t: Tilbury is the City of Delta's industrial district on the south arm of the Fraser River, between Ladner and North Delta.

The industrial streets are River Road / River Way, Tilbury Road, Hopcott Road, Progress Way, Vantage Way and 72 Street / 80 Street, in the Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road) corridor, with Tilbury Island in the Fraser River; boundary detail from a City industrial map: UNVERIFIED.
Nearby areas: Ladner (East Delta) to the south-west, Annieville and Nordel to the east along River Road, and Annacis Island across the Highway 91 corridor to the north-east.

Land use in one line: the Delta Official Community Plan 2024 (Bylaw No. 8400) states Delta's industries are primarily located along River Road East, in Tilbury Industrial Park, Annacis Island and Roberts Bank, with pockets along River Road West and at Boundary Bay Airport; Delta's industrially zoned and designated land totaled 1,527 hectares in Metro Vancouver's 2020 Regional Industrial Lands Inventory, approximately 13% of the region's overall inventory.

The one City recreation facility inside the industrial area is Tilbury Ice, the arena at 7187 Vantage Way (at 72 Street); a City lease posting for its restaurant space describes the surrounding area as mainly industrial warehouse space, off River Road at 72 Street and Vantage Way, with Highway 17 / SFPR proximity, between Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge and Highway 99 / Massey Tunnel.

No public school, City park, Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, shopping centre or grocery store inside the Tilbury industrial lands was confirmed in official sources. School District 37 catchments are address-based through the SD37 School Locator, and the Tilbury industrial area has no residential catchment population of its own.
Transit: a TransLink route serving inside the Tilbury industrial lands was not confirmed from a timetable; the nearest exchanges are Ladner Exchange and Scottsdale Exchange.

Roads and flood context: River Road and River Way are the frontage routes and the South Fraser Perimeter Road / Highway 17 alignment runs through the Tilbury Industrial area per City application material. Tilbury Island and the River Road lands are Fraser River riverfront industrial lands inside Delta's dike system; the City is the diking authority and operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure citywide; parcel-level Flood Construction Level detail: UNVERIFIED.
Health care: the nearest hospital is Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner (Fraser Health); the North Delta Public Health Unit is at 11245 84 Avenue.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Tilbury

items.t: Why there is no townhouse stock — the plan layer: the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), covers Tilbury as industrial land — a single consolidated plan with NO lettered schedules (the former area plans sat under the repealed Bylaw No. 3950, and Tilbury was not among its residential neighbourhoods in any case). There is no residential designation for the Tilbury industrial lands in the plan.

Zoning — number flagged, not asserted: City material for Tilbury-area properties references the I2 and I7 industrial zone codes; the full industrial zone names and minimum lot standards were not confirmed from a City zone sheet — UNVERIFIED. Permitted-use, outdoor-storage and parking rules differ by zone, so a use that works in one bay can be prohibited two streets over.

SSMUH does not create townhouses here: Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing bylaws (Bylaws No. 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) apply to single-detached and duplex lots; Tilbury's industrial lands are not single-detached residential lots, so SSMUH is not a route to housing in the industrial park.

Strata law still applies — to industrial strata: on an industrial strata resale the strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate (Strata Property Act s. 59 — fees, amounts owing, approved levies, CRF balance, insurance summary, with rules, budget and the most recent depreciation report attached). Depreciation reports: since July 1, 2024, stratas with five or more lots must obtain one every five years, not deferrable by vote — this reaches industrial stratas too. CRF minimum: since November 1, 2023, at least 10% of the annual operating budget must go to the contingency reserve fund. For an industrial unit, add a Phase I environmental site assessment for the unit's and the complex's prior uses to the usual residential-style strata read.

Rental and age bylaws (for completeness): long-term rental-restriction bylaws have been VOID since November 24, 2022, short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, and the only permitted age bylaw under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 (Reg 7.01 exemptions expanded May 1, 2023) is a 55+ bylaw — none of this creates a residential use on industrial land, and no residential or age-restricted use is stated for any Tilbury industrial strata.

Living in an industrial unit — UNCONFIRMED, do not assume: no source checked states any residential, caretaker-suite or live-work permission in Tilbury's industrial zones (City material references I2 and I7 codes; the full zone standards were not confirmed from a City zone sheet). Do not price or market a Tilbury unit as livable without the parcel's zone sheet and a City answer in hand.

Flood homework is a first subject on any riverfront parcel: Tilbury Island and the River Road lands are Fraser River riverfront lands inside Delta's dike system, so confirm the parcel's Flood Construction Level, dike setbacks and any Section 219 flood covenants on title before subject removal — for an industrial purchase exactly as for a home.

ALR and lease status on edge parcels: City material shows farm use leases on some Tilbury-area parcels, and ALR status is parcel-specific through the Agricultural Land Commission — a leased or ALR parcel does not price like a clean freehold industrial lot. An ALR residence also cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)), which is one more reason no strata townhouse product can appear on ALR edge parcels.

Buyer frame (general BC layer, for buyers redirected to residential Delta sub-areas): FTHB GST rebate — Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122 (100% of GST to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements March 20, 2025–2031); New Housing Rebate 36% / maximum $6,300 / $350K–$450K; PTT with the First-Time Home Buyers' exemption (no PTT on the first $500,000 at $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000) and the Newly Built Home Exemption (full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000); Home Buyers' Plan $60,000; FHSA $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 per year; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%; REDMA s. 21 7-day rescission / s. 18 trust deposits where a presale exists elsewhere. Fee-simple contrast for those redirected searches: a fee-simple townhouse carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees — municipal rules plus registered covenants/HOA only. None of that frame has a Tilbury townhouse to attach to.

"Tilbury" in a housing search is the industrial park's name spilling into postal addresses. A townhouse search filtered to "Tilbury" returns industrial strata and farm-edge houses wearing a postal label.

Delta's industrial land base is regionally significant, and Tilbury is a named pillar of it. The OCP cites Metro Vancouver's 2020 Regional Industrial Lands Inventory: 1,527 hectares of industrially zoned and designated land, approximately 13% of the region's overall inventory — the industrial designation here is the plan, not a placeholder awaiting housing.

The Highway 17 alignment runs through the industrial area. City application material shows Tilbury Industrial area properties affected by the South Fraser Perimeter Road alignment — frontage and access on specific parcels can be shaped by that corridor, which is an industrial-buyer diligence item, not a commute amenity for residents who do not exist here.

The area's best-known industrial neighbour is an LNG plant. Any buyer of a nearby farm or riverfront home is buying beside an active LNG and warehouse district, which belongs in the due-diligence conversation.

There is exactly one civic gathering point inside the district. Tilbury Ice at 7187 Vantage Way is the one City recreation facility inside the industrial area — there is no residential amenity base (no school, park or library branch) confirmed inside the lands, which is the simplest field test of the zero in.

Farm leases touch the edges. City material shows farm use leases on some Tilbury-area parcels, and ALR status is parcel-specific through the Agricultural Land Commission — a leased or ALR edge parcel does not price or transact like a clean freehold industrial lot, and an ALR residence cannot be stratified in any case.

Land use, as the OCP states it: the Delta Official Community Plan 2024 (Bylaw No. 8400) states Delta's industries are primarily located along River Road East, in Tilbury Industrial Park, Annacis Island and Roberts Bank, with pockets of industry along River Road West and at Boundary Bay Airport; Delta's industrially zoned and designated land totaled 1,527 hectares in Metro Vancouver's 2020 Regional Industrial Lands Inventory, approximately 13% of the region's overall inventory.

Form 1 — freehold industrial lots: freehold industrial lots trade in Tilbury alongside the strata bays — industrial freehold, the default fee-simple form for this district, not residential fee-simple lot product.

Form 2 — industrial strata lots (NOT bare-land strata, and NOT residential): industrial strata units — small-bay and mid-bay warehouse/office strata complexes on streets like Progress Way and Vantage Way — trade as industrial premises.
Named land areas, by name only as the sources state them: Tilbury Industrial Park and Tilbury Island — the City's own names for these industrial lands.

Major industry present, not a development offering: the FortisBC Tilbury LNG facility is the area's best-known industrial operation; expansion approval detail from an official project page: UNVERIFIED (not confirmed in the sources read). It is an operating industrial facility, not land inventory.

Lot character: industrial parcel standards: UNVERIFIED — the full I2 / I7 zone names and minimum lot standards for Tilbury were not confirmed from a City zone sheet, so no industrial lot size, width or coverage figure is stated here. Confirm the zone and standards for any parcel on the City zoning maps.

Typical buyer, as stated in the research: owner-user businesses and industrial investors — logistics, warehousing, manufacturing and service-industrial users buying strata bays or freehold sites near Highways 17, 91 and 99; stated as a fit with the sourced land-use facts above, not a statistic.

ALR / lease edge parcels: farm use leases on some Tilbury-area parcels appear in City material; ALR status for a specific parcel is a check through the Agricultural Land Commission — a leased or ALR parcel does not price like a clean freehold industrial lot. No ALR percentage split for Tilbury is stated.

Serviced vs unserviced / flood servicing position: Tilbury Island and the River Road lands are Fraser River riverfront industrial lands inside Delta's dike system; the City is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure citywide; dyke and flood-construction-level detail for specific parcels: UNVERIFIED. Parcel-level water/sewer servicing beyond that dike/drainage position: UNCONFIRMED in the research.
: Tilbury is designated industrial land in the OCP, and no residential housing mix was confirmed inside the Tilbury industrial lands.

Market figures: NONE cited, by design: The SnapStats FVR September 2026 report contains no Tilbury sub-area row — its Delta coverage is the North Delta community and its four residential sub-areas only — so no SnapStats figures exist for Tilbury in this report. Industrial market figures (rents, vacancy, land values): UNVERIFIED — no other source was substituted in the research, and none is substituted here.

Highway 17 / South Fraser Perimeter Road alignment: City application material shows Tilbury Industrial area properties affected by the South Fraser Perimeter Road alignment. That is a corridor affecting parcels, not a lot offering.
No residential conversion proposal is documented: Do not pay a housing-hope premium on industrial land here.

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC — Tilbury is the industrial district on the south arm of the Fraser River, between Ladner and North Delta.

Tilbury is not one of the residential neighbourhoods named in the former North Delta Area Plan (Schedule C.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950); the City treats it as an industrial area — the Tilbury Industrial Park / Tilbury Island lands in the Fraser River.

Boundaries: industrial lands along River Road / River Way, Tilbury Road, Hopcott Road, Progress Way, Vantage Way and 72 Street / 80 Street, in the Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road) corridor, with Tilbury Island in the Fraser River; boundary detail from a City industrial map: UNVERIFIED.
Search / alternate names: "Tilbury Industrial Park" (the common business name); "Tilbury Island"; "River Road industrial"; "South Fraser Perimeter Road corridor."

Roads and commute: River Road and River Way are the frontage routes; the South Fraser Perimeter Road / Highway 17 alignment runs through the Tilbury Industrial area per City application material; Highway 91 and Highway 99 access is from the Tilbury area. A City truck-route page for Tilbury: UNVERIFIED.

Recreation: Tilbury Ice, the City of Delta arena at 7187 Vantage Way (at 72 Street), is the one City recreation facility inside the industrial area; a City lease posting for its restaurant space describes the surrounding area as mainly industrial warehouse space, off River Road at 72 Street and Vantage Way, with Highway 17 / SFPR proximity, between Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge and Highway 99 / Massey Tunnel.

Schools: no public school inside Tilbury was confirmed in the sources read; School District 37 catchments are address-based through the SD37 School Locator, and the Tilbury industrial area has no residential catchment population of its own.
Parks / libraries / shopping: no City park, Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, shopping centre or grocery store inside the Tilbury industrial lands was confirmed in official sources.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Tilbury

items.t: Zoning — codes documented, standards and bylaw number flagged: City material for Tilbury-area properties references the I2 and I7 industrial zone codes; the full industrial zone names and minimum lot standards were not confirmed from a City zone sheet — UNVERIFIED. Permitted-use, outdoor-storage and parking rules differ by zone, so a use that works in one bay can be prohibited two streets over — verify the exact zone and permitted uses on the City zoning maps before anything else.

SSMUH does not create housing here: Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing bylaws (Bylaws No. 8394 and 8395, adopted June 24, 2024) apply to single-detached and duplex lots; Tilbury's industrial lands are not single-detached residential lots, so SSMUH is not a route to housing in the industrial park.

Flood / dike diligence — a first subject: Tilbury Island and the River Road lands are Fraser River riverfront lands inside Delta's dike system, so confirm the parcel's Flood Construction Level, dike setbacks and any Section 219 flood covenants on title before subject removal — for an industrial purchase exactly as for a home.

Industrial strata block (applies to the strata bays): on an industrial strata resale the strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate (Strata Property Act s. Add a Phase I environmental site assessment for the unit's and the complex's prior uses to the usual strata read.

ALR rules (edge parcels where ALR applies): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); BC Assessment farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Property transfer tax + GST — commercial treatment UNCONFIRMED: Tilbury is commercial/industrial land. At the general level only: GST on vacant land at CRA GI-003 level — developer/business sales and newly subdivided lots generally TAXABLE; an individual's sale of personal-use land generally exempt — with anything finer, and any commercial-specific application, UNCONFIRMED for Tilbury.

FTHB GST rebate / housing programs — not a Tilbury land item: the FTHB rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122; 100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031) applies to new HOUSING, not bare land — and not to industrial land. It is stated here only to close the question a redirected residential buyer may ask. New Housing Rebate 36% / maximum $6,300 / $350K–$450K; Home Buyers' Plan $60,000; FHSA $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 per year — residential programs, none documented as applying to a Tilbury industrial purchase.

The City's own marketing for Tilbury sells highways, not housing. The City's Tilbury Ice lease brochure markets the area's position between Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge and Highway 99 / Massey Tunnel, off River Road at 72 Street and Vantage Way, with Highway 17 / SFPR proximity.

The best-known industrial neighbour is an LNG plant. Any buyer of a nearby farm or riverfront parcel is buying beside an active LNG and warehouse district, which belongs in the due-diligence conversation.

faq.a: No. The Delta OCP treats Tilbury as industrial land — Tilbury Industrial Park is named with River Road East, Annacis Island and Roberts Bank as Delta's main industry locations — and no residential housing mix was confirmed inside the industrial lands in City sources.

The South Fraser Perimeter Road (Highway 17) alignment runs through the Tilbury Industrial area per City application material, and the City's Tilbury Ice posting places the area between Highway 91 / Alex Fraser Bridge and Highway 99 / Massey Tunnel off River Road.

faq.q: Is Tilbury behind the dike system?
faq.a: Tilbury Island and the River Road lands are Fraser River riverfront lands; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure — parcel-level Flood Construction Level and covenant detail must be confirmed per property.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Are there any townhouses in Tilbury at all?
faq.a: No — zero verified, strata or fee-simple. Tilbury is designated industrial land in the OCP, and no residential housing mix was confirmed inside the industrial lands in City sources.

faq.q: A listing says "Tilbury" but shows a house — how?
faq.a: Postal-area naming is wider than the industrial park: dwellings carrying a Tilbury-area address sit on surrounding Ladner / East Delta farm and riverfront parcels, outside the industrial park lands. Check which side of the industrial boundary the parcel is on before treating it as Tilbury product — and run that parcel's own ALR, flood and zoning checks as a Ladner/East Delta purchase.

faq.q: Are the strata bays on Progress Way / Vantage Way a cheap way to "buy a townhouse"?
faq.a: No. They are strata industrial units, not homes: permitted uses, outdoor storage and parking differ by zone (City material references I2 and I7 codes in Tilbury), and a use that works in one bay can be prohibited two streets over. Living in one is UNCONFIRMED as permitted on any source checked — do not buy on that assumption.

faq.q: Could I get a caretaker suite or live-work setup in an industrial unit?
faq.a: No source checked states any residential, caretaker-suite or live-work permission in Tilbury's industrial zones, and the full I2/I7 zone standards were not confirmed from a City zone sheet — UNCONFIRMED. Get the parcel's zone sheet and a City answer before pricing any unit as livable.

faq.q: Where is the nearest actual townhouse stock?
faq.a: No source checked names a specific nearest townhouse complex to Tilbury, so any "closest complex" claim is UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: Is Tilbury a residential neighbourhood where I can buy a lot to build a house?
faq.a: No. The Delta OCP treats Tilbury as industrial land — Tilbury Industrial Park is named with River Road East, Annacis Island and Roberts Bank as Delta's main industry locations — and no residential housing mix was confirmed inside the industrial lands in City sources.

faq.q: What land actually trades in Tilbury?
faq.a: Industrial land in two forms: freehold industrial lots, and industrial strata lots (small-bay and mid-bay warehouse/office strata complexes on streets like Progress Way and Vantage Way). Typical buyers are owner-user businesses and industrial investors near Highways 17, 91 and 99.

faq.q: How big are Tilbury industrial lots, and what are the I2 / I7 standards?
faq.a: UNVERIFIED — the full industrial zone names and minimum lot standards were not confirmed from a City zone sheet in the research.
